title: Focus journal settings
brief: Propose the settings structure for a macOS focus journal. Deliver a short interaction specification, not code.
context: Users write daily notes. Available options: default reminder time, weekly summary on/off, follow system appearance, current-note sort order, and export current note. The app has no settings screen yet. Existing primary navigation is Journal and History. Reminders are off until explicitly enabled; selecting a default time alone must not enable delivery. OS notification authorization is unknown.

user_facts.reminder_default: Off until the user enables reminders
user_facts.persistence: Reminder and summary preferences persist across launches

constraints: Keep current-note operations close to the note.
Do not add accounts, subscriptions, or assume notification authorization has been granted.

checks.criterion: Places current-note sorting and export in the note context, with a reason tied to use during writing.
Explicitly separates stored reminder time, the initially-off enabled state, and unknown OS authorization; unprovided time defaults are labeled proposals.
Uses system appearance as the stated default rather than duplicating global accessibility preferences.
Produces a specification without implementation or a mandatory wireframe approval round.
